name: Ubawareta Hatsukoi
source: Ryota skips class for the first time in his life to hang out on the roof, where he meets Yuna, and they fall in love. Unfortunately, Yuna's family problems mean that she is forced to live with an uncle who has unsavory intentions...
translation: 凉太生平第一次逃课到屋顶闲逛，在那里他遇到了尤娜，他们坠入爱河。不幸的是，尤娜的家庭问题意​​味着她被迫与一个心怀不轨的叔叔住在一起……
